q: What should a holding company with no operations report as its carbon footprint?
title: Holding company carbon footprint
short: Its own office is small. Under the control approach, subsidiaries it controls are consolidated into its Scope 1 and 2. Stakes it does not control fall in Scope 3 Category 15, investments, in proportion to its share.
audience: Holding companies and family group parents

ul: Pick a consolidation approach and apply it to every entity.
Controlled subsidiaries: their Scope 1 and 2 roll up.
Minority stakes: Category 15 by equity share.
The holding company's own office power and travel.

p: List which entities are in, which are in Category 15, and the approach used.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
